title: Why Your Cards Keep You Broke
description:
Discover how credit cards and digital wallets bypass your brain's natural pain receptors, leading you to spend more. Learn how to manually reintroduce friction into your transactions to regain control over your money.

Free 7-day Money Reset checklist + calculators: https://youngstunners88.github.io/quiet-money/money-reset/

Educational content, not financial advice. Narration and visuals are AI-assisted.
